I am just using shiny 0.14 with modalDialogs. This works fine for text output (like a simple string or a command like includeMarkdown).

messages.subject: Re: Modals and ggplot-graphs
parts:
Hi,

You just have to put output in the modalDialog :

library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
shinyApp(
  ui = basicPage(
    actionButton("show", "Show modal dialog")
  ),
  server = function(input, output) {
    observeEvent(input$show, {
      showModal(modalDialog(
        title = "Important message",
        plotOutput("graph")
      ))
    })
    output$graph<-renderPlot({
      ggplot(data.frame(x=1:5,y=5:1),aes(x=x,y=y))+geom_point()
    })
  }
)


Best regards,
Dominique
